# Feature: Crumbling tile — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #5 (Crumbling tile) from Terrain and Hazards before it is used in real levels. Effect: breaks one step after you leave. Unique: the tile goes after you leave it, not while you stand on it. Useful: burns the retreat path, so visit order matters. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** breaks one step after you leave.

**So that** burns the retreat path, so visit order matters.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Crumbling tile for the first time in its teaching room (mech-5-crumbling-tile-room). Teaching moment: First room: a crumbling crossing with an orb on the far side and something worth returning for. A player who crosses, collects, and turns back finds the tile they left has fallen and must take the long way or restart, which teaches that the crossing is spent by leaving it rather than by standing on it. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Safe while you stand on it
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: One move after you leave, it falls and becomes a void tile for the rest of the attempt
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Restarts and checkpoints restore it

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Crumbling tile's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-5-crumbling-tile-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/terrain-and-hazards.yml mechanic #5.
